setting: A couple's fancy dinner plans fall through, so they cook pasta and dance in their kitchen instead.

lyricConnections.explanationJa: all week は『一週間ずっと』。ここでは二人の夜をずっと楽しみにしていたことを表す。
take our time は『焦らずゆっくりする』。食事や二人の時間を急がず楽しむときに使える。
our favorite song は『私たちのお気に入りの曲』。共有している思い出を自然に会話に入れられる。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: The restaurant just canceled our booking.
sentences.displayHtml: The restaurant just canceled our booking.

sentences.text: I've been looking forward to tonight all week.
sentences.displayHtml: I've been looking forward to tonight all week.

conversation.japanese: レストランから、予約を取り消したいって連絡が来た。一週間ずっと今夜を楽しみにしてたのに。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: We've got pasta and a bottle of wine.
sentences.displayHtml: We've got pasta and a bottle of wine.

sentences.text: Who says we have to go out?
sentences.displayHtml: Who says we have to go out?

conversation.japanese: パスタもワインもあるよ。別に出かけなきゃいけないわけじゃないでしょ？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I wanted to do something special for you.
sentences.displayHtml: I wanted to do something special for you.

conversation.japanese: 君のために、ちょっと特別なことをしたかったんだ。こういう予定じゃなかったのに。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Then put on our favorite song.
sentences.displayHtml: Then put on our favorite song.

sentences.text: We can take our time cooking instead of watching the clock.
sentences.displayHtml: We can take our time cooking instead of watching the clock.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、二人のお気に入りの曲をかけて。時計を気にしないで、ゆっくり料理しようよ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: You mean dancing in the kitchen counts as a date?
sentences.displayHtml: You mean dancing in the kitchen counts as a date?

conversation.japanese: つまり、キッチンで踊るのもデートってことでいい？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Absolutely, as long as you don't burn the garlic.
sentences.displayHtml: Absolutely, as long as you don't burn the garlic.

conversation.japanese: もちろん。ニンニクを焦がさなければね。
